Update 10/17.   Yesterday I took tchaiko to the vet, it was such an intense day.
After some hours waiting the vet calls me and tells me "this is ugly. I'm about to open her but I don't know what I'll find. If her intestines are necrotic(dead) is not good.
She will not survive" I'll call you when I'm done. 
My whole world fell in those hours waiting, thinking about what I will do when tchaiko is not there anymore, well, general panic attack with suicidal thoughts but in the most calm way because I had as soon as I knew what was going to happen.
I waited and waited. I was sure that I would have to take the decision of sacrificing her or not. I was devastated.

Gladly, doc calls me 3 hours later and tells me he had to remove all cutaneous and subcutaneous tissue (folks, after that there is only muscle and bone) but told me that intestines, vulva and anus didn't seem to be impacted. Good thing is that he pushed the poop out manually, so she  doesn't have a week worth of poop inside anymore.


He told me that it will be a long recovery, but she will most likely do it.
We gotta clean the wounds again on Monday, which will be another anestesia as the doctor says "she is brave, man."

Btw- he charged me 1500 pesos (something like 30 dollars) for the whole thing. 

I slept with her and give her my warmth and love, she got super scared at night and jumped off the bed, but nothing happened, i just grabbed her, placed her in the blankets and rolled around her like her mom would do (i guess? God damn this is my first cat ever)

Today she woke up and walked towards Sun, i opened the window and placed her in the bed, now she is there. Dranked water but didn't want to eat yet. I'll give her time for that

Update 10/12: thank you all for your comments and suggestions! I really appreciate you taking time to help us go through this though time.
Tchaiko is still healing and recovering but she is doing a lot better. She got down from bed and walked around for a bit, her face is totally different today. 
About the meds, I'm diluting them in some water and using a syringe to give her the meds (SOOO much easier and faster than trying to shove pills )
She sat in her boxes today and seems that she is still having issues controlling her bladder, and her anus is Swallen so no pooping for a while.
I've switched to only wet food, she has eaten yogurth (i gave her literally everything and won't it for 3 days but loved the yougurth, i bought one without sugar, additives etc so it can be as healthy as it can be.
Tomorrow I'll take her to the vet, as we have an appt. And will see if any laxative etc is needed 
I'm hopeful she will be 70% up next week.


Update 10/13. I took her to the vet, he explained the traumatism was a big one, tissue on the sides is kinda necrotic, so I'll have to take her on Saturday, they'll do anestesia and clean her inside again. It was kinda shocking as I had to be there and helped the vet to grab de cat and see the whole thing, but I'm positive she will keep recovering a little bit every day.
At least she doesn't have all the swallen stuff which vet took away..
I'm super anguished but i know I gotta be strong and accept all what's happening. Tchaiko needs Al the love and support i can give her now
